dirs.description: Directories to search for projects. Paths ending in '/' list all subdirectories as projects. Supports ~ expansion.

default_sources.description: Sources shown by default when 'meow switch' launches, and when the default keybinding is pressed. Valid values: open, local, remote, set, history.

alias_spacing.description: Width in characters of the alias/shortname column in the project picker.

name_spacing.description: Width in characters of the project name column; annotations (SSH URL, timestamp) align after this.

template.description: Commands to run when opening a new project tab (e.g. editor and shell).

fzf.description: Path to the fzf binary. Useful on macOS where fzf may not be on PATH (e.g. /opt/homebrew/bin/fzf).

github.description: GitHub usernames and/or organization names to fetch remote repos from.

keybindings.description: fzf key bindings for switching between project sources. Do not use ctrl-p or ctrl-n (reserved by fzf for navigation).

default.description: Show all tabs and local projects (default view).

remote.description: Fetch and show GitHub remote repos.

history.description: Show recently opened projects from history.
